summary: Search engines surface podcast episodes and videos that use Conrad Alan Rockenhaus's name. Conrad states some of those appearances and channels are associated with the opposing party or disputed accounts, and are not authoritative statements by him. Compare titles and claims to filed Michigan documents on rockenhaus.net and to his verified profiles (@skyphusion).
